items.summary: Chile's far-right President José Antonio Kast is facing mounting public anger, as rising fuel prices trigger transport strikes and protests across the country.

items.title: France marks 11th anniversary of Paris attacks with tribute at Stade de France
items.summary: France is marking the 11th anniversary of the November 2015 Paris terrorist attacks on Friday, with commemorations honouring the 130 people killed. This year the Stade de France, one of the sites targeted by the attackers, hosts a sporting event on 13 November for the first time since the tragedy.

items.title: France escalates Algeria trade dispute to EU-level
items.summary: France on Friday asked the European Commission to look into Algeria’s alleged non-compliance with a EU trade deal. Paris is accusing Algers of an almost total blockade on French imports and of suspending urea shipments to France.

items.title: Meet the Fans Who Traveled to Bangkok for Eurovision Asia
items.summary: Some were Asia-based Europeans chasing nostalgia. Others were Americans eager to experience their first edition of the song contest.

items.title: Asia’s Eurovision Contest Is Missing China, India, Pakistan, Indonesia and Japan
items.summary: China, India, Pakistan, Indonesia and Japan aren’t joining the singing contest. That leave some of the region’s best-known musical cultures out of the mix.
